regime_context: Hong Kong thematic ranks show narrow, half-crowded leadership concentrated in Banks (durability 0.62, breadth 0.85, but mean-revert tagged and crowded z=1.15) with Energy the only trend-tagged eligible theme. Macro backdrop is ai_tech/geopolitics headline-driven with 100% unscheduled share — coincident noise, no trigger.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is rank-2, eligible, the only top-3 theme with a clean 'trend' hurst tag and durability_bar 0.71 (highest among eligible leaders), breadth 0.70, and is NOT crowded (z=0.31). It is the most regime-consistent candidate for continued trend-following under the absolute-trend gate: high durability plus trend-hurst argues the staying-power leg is least likely to be disrupted near-term.
theses.dissent: Energy is an H-share proxy to global oil/gas flows; unscheduled macro share is 100% and the dominant headline themes are ai_tech and geopolitics, neither directly supportive — a geopolitics shock could whipsaw commodities. Cross-sectional rank has ~0 forward IC, so the #2 rank carries no predictive authority.

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Rank-3, eligible, mixed hurst with durability 0.68 and breadth 0.75, not crowded (0.35). As a third-leg income theme it complements the trend-gated Energy read; the gate favours staying-power names, and High-Dividend is the cleanest uncrowded eligible income exposure.
evidence: hurst_tag mixed, not mean-revert like Banks
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst tag is not a clear trend endorsement; dividend blue chips are typically defensive and lag in a risk-on rotation; high-dividend yield chasing in HK has historically underperformed aggressive tech cycles when they turn.
